releaseNotes:
• Complete Translator Fix: Fixed 'Translating...' infinite loop by eliminating request cancellation churn and adding isTranslating guard
• High-Speed Google Mobile & Chrome Engines: Upgraded translation backend to official client=at and clients5 APIs with fixed array parsing and low timeouts
• Singlish Intelligent Resolution: Singlish phonetic phrases (e.g., mama heta ennam) now auto-resolve to Sinhala and translate to English seamlessly
• Smart Language Auto-Switching: Typing Sinhala automatically selects English as target; typing English selects Sinhala
• One-Tap Paste & Translate: Added quick Clipboard Paste button directly in the translation panel
